hypothesis: Time-conditioned confirmation-failure exit for ALREADY ENTERED full-size MR40+Momentum30 spot position, compared with unchanged baseline. Distinct from prior pre-entry confirm3, forced 40-bar cap and price-only fixed stops. Evaluate if exiting an episode with no favorable closed-candle recovery in first 3 or 6 bars reduces worst account drawdown without excessive opportunity loss.
execution: Enter 100% free cash on original MR40+Momentum30 entry at next Open with venue lot/fees. Starting from entry Open, observe CLOSE on first N entire four-hour candles including entry candle; exactly once when candle N has fully closed, check the MAX of those N completed CLOSE values against actual executed entry price*(1+minimum_favorable_close). If not reached, issue immediate SELL to execute at next available Open subject to profile lag; original natural exit pending for same Open takes precedence. Natural exit remains original Z>=0; no forced stop apart from fixed period-terminal liquidation. If confirmation reached, original position continues without a new initial stop. Exit for failed confirmation cannot use future highs or lows. Freeze one decision at N only; not re-evaluate. After fused exit block any buy for the remainder of original episode, even if its signal persists. No leverage / no partial trade / no intrabar assumption.
fundamentals: Closing an initial position before it has first demonstrated a positive close does not protect against the FIRST 3/6 bars' adverse intrabar move, overnight gap, or slippage. Never call this a stop-loss or a guarantee.
selection: Use training only. Profit qualification: normal PnL>=baseline, stress PnL>=1.05*baseline stress, worst(normal,stress) close DD<=1.10*baseline. Efficiency qualification: normal CAGR>=.75*baseline, stress CAGR>0, worst close DD<=.90*baseline, stress-CAGR / worst DD >=1.10*baseline. Winners maximum training stress PnL / stress-CAGR-to-worst-DD respectively, else baseline. Locked evaluation qualifies only if profits both profiles >=.75*baseline, worst close DD<=.80*baseline worst, efficiency >=1.10*baseline. No threshold retuning after evaluation. Label all conclusions exploratory.
validation: Exact original baseline parity on frozen windows, Decimal-ledger independent fill and cash replay, chronological trigger/candle-count invariance, synthetic lag/exit/no re-entry/capital and decision-priority checks, temporal prefix invariance, original input digests, all evidence SHA256 in Git. No active Paper or exchange access.
